title: Divide Array in Sets of K Consecutive Numbers
description: Check if an array can be divided into sets of k consecutive numbers using a frequency map and sorting.
pseudocode: 1. Sort nums. 2. Count frequencies in map. 3. For each num in sorted unique keys: 4. If freq[num] > 0: 5. For i from 0 to k-1: 6. If freq[num+i] == 0 return false, else decrement freq.

steps.note: Forming set starting at 1: [1, 2, 3, 4]. Decrement frequencies.
Move to next available value: 3. Remaining freq: {3:1, 4:1, 5:1, 6:1}
Forming set starting at 3: [3, 4, 5, 6]. Decrement frequencies.
All elements processed successfully. Return true.
